replay.candidatesNotice: Finding directories does not scan or index replays. Choose a directory to scan manually.
replay.noDirectories: No standard account replay directory found. You can still scan a custom directory.
replay.duplicateNotice: Grouped by indexed SHA-256; files are never merged or deleted automatically. Reindex changed files to update groups.
replay.exportNotice: Selection persists across filters. Export up to 2,000 replays / 1 GiB. Choose a new ZIP path; existing files are never overwritten. Reindex old or changed files first.
replay.analysisNotice: These are decoded protocol components, not APM, build orders or economy analytics. Completed means all three components were decoded.
replay.noAnalysis: No current saved analysis. It may never have run, or the source content / parser version has changed. Reindex changed files before analyzing.
replay.componentUnavailable: This component was not decoded. See the status and warnings above.
replay.previewTruncated: Preview truncated; this is not the complete component.
replay.noItems: Decoded successfully; no records in this component.
replay.title: Replay library
replay.description: Only manually added replays are listed. No automatic scanning; metadata support depends on the replay version.
replay.search: Search file, map, player or path
replay.empty: No indexed replays. Scan a directory or add a replay.
replay.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes the replay file from disk and its index record. This cannot be undone.
replay.partialNotice: Only parsed metadata is shown; match analytics are not available.
